pages.title: Psionic Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that resonates with thought. Its lattice responds to the faint magnetic fields of a working brain the way cryptochrome in a bird's eye responds to the Earth's field. When I concentrate it hums; when I am distracted it falls quiet. A science that should not exist, and yet.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Psionic Resonator I joined a Superposition Crystal to a Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor in Synaptic Fluid. When I thought hard about a colour, the crystal's indecision collapsed toward it. I did not sleep that night.
